visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a screen recording of the mobile game Honor of Kings. The player's character, a winged female avatar, is positioned inside a patch of tall green grass within a stylized fantasy battleground. The UI displays a mini-map in the top-left, skill icons in the bottom-right, and health bars. (2) The character suddenly leaps from the grass into the river area to engage in combat. The screen becomes crowded with glowing purple skill effects, circular AOE markers, and floating damage numbers in various colors. Multiple enemy characters are visible nearby. (3) As the combat intensifies, a semi-transparent overlay of a real man's face appears over the gameplay. He has dark hair and a light-colored shirt, exhibiting a facial expression of extreme distress and shock, with his mouth wide open. (4) The gameplay concludes with the character's health reaching zero, and the man's face remains superimposed as a comedic reaction element.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator speaks in a calm, confident gaming tone, explaining a strategy. The background is nearly silent, only subtle game interface sounds. (2) As combat initiates, the speaker's tone shifts to high-arousal shouting. Transient SFX from in-game skill uses (whooshing and magical impact sounds) populate the mix. (3) A heavy hip-hop track with electronic synths and a strong trap beat kicks in. The speaker yells in frustration with audible vocal strain as the character's situation worsens. (4) The vocal performance becomes an exaggerated high-pitched wail or crying sound, synchronized with the rhythmic music track to create a comedic effect.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain viewers by highlighting a common and relatable gaming 'fail.' It contrasts the player's initial tactical instructions with a disastrous team fight result, capped with a humorous meme-style reaction.
